name: Pink Foldable Nurse Clipboard with Reference Charts
seoTitle: Pink Foldable Nurse Clipboard for Students
metaDescription: A pink foldable aluminum nurse clipboard with reference charts, a low profile clip, and a pen holder, a cheerful and practical nursing student gift.
summary: A pink folding clipboard with reference charts and a pen clip, a bright and useful gift for a nursing student or new nurse.
whyItWorks: Pens go missing on every unit. They get borrowed, pocketed, and left in patient rooms, which is why a clipboard with its own pen clip is such a quietly helpful feature. Combine that with a low profile clip that holds report sheets flat and a set of nursing reference charts, and the whole shift's notes live in one place.

Pink gives it personality, and it is easy to spot in a pile of gray clipboards at the nurses station. The three layer aluminum design folds into a pocket friendly size, so it does not have to be set down and forgotten. Nursing students tend to love these for clinical rotations, when they are writing everything down and still learning normal ranges. It is also a solid pick for a graduation or pinning gift basket, sitting alongside a badge reel, a stethoscope ID tag, and some good pens. For a student who likes cheerful gear, the color makes it feel like a gift rather than a supply.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for which reference charts are included inside.
A pen is not mentioned as included, so add a favorite pen to the gift.
Confirm the folded size if they wear small scrub pockets.

faq.q: Is this a good pinning ceremony gift?
faq.a: Yes, it is practical for the first year of nursing and the pink color makes it feel celebratory.

faq.q: Does it come in other colors?
faq.a: The title lists pink. Check the listing to see whether other colors are offered.
